params.body:
Closes #455

## What was wrong

nginx sends `Content-Security-Policy: ... script-src 'self'` on every response of observatory.gentells.com (`docs/nginx-security-headers.sh`, since 2026-09-11). The citation review page (`GET /articles/:id/review/page`, ProveML's `reviewPage`) ran entirely on inline scripts: the page script, `PROVEML_REVIEW_SUBMIT` and `PROVEML_REVIEW_COMMITTED`. The browser blocked all three. In the Studio the page rendered and nothing on it responded: clicking a citation left the Source panel empty, there was no "sign review", and the Publish gate stayed on "not reviewed yet".

Sending a looser policy from the pipeline would not help, because a browser enforces the nginx header next to it.

## What changes

- `externalizeScripts(html, url)` in `article-review.mjs` takes the page's executable inline scripts out in document order and joins them into one script. A single `<script src>` replaces them at the place of the last one. The `text/plain` snapshot blocks stay inline as data, and a module or an external script is left alone.
- `GET /articles/:id/review/page.js?t=` serves that script under the same review token as the page. The page and the script are built from the same input (`reviewPageUrls`), so they always agree.
- Nothing in the page uses inline event handlers or eval, so `script-src 'self'` is now satisfied.

## Checked

- `test/article-review.test.mjs`: the served page has no running inline script, only `page.js?t=…`. The snapshots stay inline. The script carries the submit url and the page script and parses, and a wrong token gets 401. A unit case covers order, data blocks, modules and external scripts.
- In headless Chromium, the page sat in a same-origin frame under the exact live CSP. The old page logged "Executing inline script violates … script-src 'self'" and its panel stayed empty, which matches the reported screenshot. The new page logged no CSP error, and clicking a citation opened its source with yes/no and "sign review".
- Full suite: 1680 pass, 0 fail.

Source: Portal mail:50.
params.title: Studio review page: serve its scripts from the same origin so the CSP lets them run
